rule_0.statement: THE JOINTS-ARE-MATERIALS LAW'S RECORDS ARE WHAT BIND DOFS, AND THEY WERE MISSING EVERYWHERE BUT THE HIPS. This lane amends the definition with a five-class taxonomy - ball_and_socket, hinge_revolute, condyled_gliding, syndesmosis_nodof, positional_contact - every class cited to a sha-pinned held record or to this definition's own pose_contacts finding, including the honest fifth class for the four in-chain corpse-pose appositions (femur-foot, humerus-hand) that no held model holds a joint record for because they are positional contacts of the scanned fetal curl, not anatomical articulations. The records are metadata WITH TEETH: a class's dof_count binds what poses may vary; geometry alone binds nothing (the tarsal receipt's verdict, now law in the records: the syndesmosis pairs discriminate geometrically yet hold NO DOF by class record). Someone can disagree: the taxonomy may mis-class a bond (the curl bonds may yet prove to be joints; the intertarsal bonds carry no held record), and the metadata may not be inert in some future reader - both disagreements are addressed below: mis-classing is a record edit by amendment (flagged for anatomical review in the records themselves), and inertness is measured here by the re-run batteries.
